## findings
1. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — C8a, exit_timing_points' fall-through is unreachable.** Symptom: the factor's baseline "more than far_days days … subtract nothing" (0 points) is the value its weight is measured against (11367.78). Root cause: a DHMO PCD termination date is at most notice + 90 days rounded to the month end (≤ 120 days after the notice), so every customer reaching the exit settlement sits on tier 1 or 2. Evidence: provider.yaml DHMO PCD parameters termination_notice_days_provider/carrier 90, termination_effective_alignment end_of_month_after_notice; this world's notice 2026-09-08 → termination 2026-12-31 (114 days). Consequence: the factor bears weight only against a treatment no exit customer can get. Location: provider_ext_exit_settlement rule (timing sentence), factors[exit_timing_points]. Relation: new in revision 1.
2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — C9, the assembly sentences name the factors.** repayment_interest: "the clock start, the grace and the minimum take the place of the standard ones, the rate add-ons are added…". exit_settlement: "the payment projection and the base exit recovery share take the place of the standard ones, … the haircut lowers the expected recovery". Consequence for this task: the computation document of both scored computations must carry a sentence announcing every factor (clock start, grace, minimum, rate add-ons; projection, base share, share points, haircut), so a reader of the computation document alone is told which factor documents exist. The "definite wrong number from the baseline alone" test (0.00 / 7323.30) is thereby weakened. The rationale's "assembly lives in plain bindings with one generic combination sentence per policy" is contradicted. Location: compute_basis of annual_rate and of exit_share/expected.
3. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — S1 (XF12): the cross-difficulty evidence contradicts the billing charter.** Frozen above. Evidence: customers.5db68465.customer_type = provider_practice vs the Group List Bill entry_gate customer_type employer_group; no dental_plans / group_eligibility_events under group 7bac97dc while it is invoiced 166.40/month (the design_rationale asserts "four eligible employees, all enrolled member_only", which no record supports). Consequence: without the uncreatable account, the withholding is 11707.80 (not 12608.40) and the settlement 11559.60 at handling time (not 12785.36). Location: initial_state.billing_accounts.4194f51a, billing_transactions (24 rows), group_contracts.7bac97dc.
4. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — S2 (XF17): notices without source records.** fdcfe7e4, a70621ee, d22ed6f8 and 16be4bce have no dhmo member records behind them. No scored value moves. Location: initial_state.provider_payment_events.
5. **SOURCE-TASK RED (proof) — P1, false receivable equation.** computations[step 14].factor_trace "plain" line and the design_rationale exit FACTOR CARD state "receivable = 39,045.75 - 22,763.85 + 71.10 = 16,329.30". The scored value 12785.36 is unaffected; the proof sentence is wrong. Location: tasks/0.json computations[2].factor_trace[-1], design_rationale.
